book.name: Matai
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Matai kaavu

content: Vakasin pakwesin lak vanôôn bop
Yesu nêêl vakasin pakwesin ti vu hil nambe,
“Anutu nanggin yite hil-ato ond lohvu omaaho lulemak ti wiing vanôôn bopaata in noow navu gako vêêh-ato.
Om wiing yite kul vaha-so be lala lanêêl vu hil sen teey sil lung laa-to nambe lanaam lanja vanôôn, le ma de nind baya be dando nêênd.

+ o 22:4 Mat 21:36*Tombe wiing kul vaha vaalu lalaah yesin-ambe nêêl vu sil having nambe, ‘Ham ana naanêêl vu hil sen saateey sil bôôy-ato naambe sa samu sate vanôôn lung la be nando. Saanêêl-ambe layiis kao bo-bop osin noow anituvakin vaalu sen danji bopaataa-to lung la, de sa samu va pin lung la gêên-ambe nando, om ham anaam in angga vanôôn-anjo.’
Om yite kul vaha-so lala lanêêl vakasin-anjo vu sil, le nind baya be me-lango le, de lala danjeen. Ti la yite kulaanôôn, de ango la in ganggin yite tatuva,
+ o 22:6 Mat 21:35*de sil vaalu lalôôh omaaho lulemak-ate kul vaha-so de layiis sil-ambe layimb.
Tombe omaaho lulemak-anju ahekalin lôôt, be wiing yite hil ngaamong vaha-so lala layiis hil sen layiis yite kul vaha-sôôto be layimb pin lôôt, de lasi kin hôôk silate taaku.
Tonde mem omaaho lulemak nêêl vu yite kul vaha-so vaalu nambe, ‘Vanôôn nok lung-ambe nando, le hil sen saateey sil bôôy-ato ond sil anipaya om me-lalaam e,
om ham ana baale mop bo-bop, de hil pin sen ham naatovu sil vuu-ju ond ham naanêêl vu sil naambe lanaam lanja vanôôn bop-anjo.’
“Nêêl nambêênjo tombe yite kul vaha-so lala daale mop bop pin-ambe lasupin hil pin sen latovu sil vu mop-anjuuto, hil anivasa osin hil anipaya having, be lalaam dando hôôk bayêên alo be pup.
Tonde omaaho lulemak lokala in nambe ji sil, tombe yi de omaaho ti me-lop lolop anivasa lohvu mando be ja vanôôn bop-anju le,
tombe omaaho lulemak nêêl vu nambe, ‘Hali, nambe vaati om game galop lolop vanôôn bop-ate le? Galokalaam danjeen in?’ Le omaahôô-ju lava ma,

+ o 22:13 Mat 8:12; 25:30; Luk 13:28*tombe omaaho lulemak nêêl vu yite kul vaha-so nambe, ‘Ham naanduuh nama yuuh vaha de ham gaate na, be na mando dôôk taaku mekanu lôôt. Vu taakuu-ju le monaasu osin janga navu be monaangitak.’”
Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Ke, Anutu nateey hil ngeeyaata, lemu naholin ti ti lak in landukana gaving yite hil.”
Lalingin Yesu in gaate taakis vu Sisa
+ o 22:15 Mak 3:6*Tombe hil Palisai yoo lala landuuh vakasin nambe sil tatuhin Yesu in nambe naanêêl vakasin na paya,

om lawiing silate hil vaalu laving Helot-ate hil vaalu be lala vu Yesu be lanêêl nambe, “Kaputung, hey alak ganim nambe hong omaaho sen onanêêl vakasin keen. Yik goo navu tatekin Anutu-te mop keen vu hil, de game nayêênin omaaho ti nambe haale bop me haale pasiv e,
om onaanêêl vu hey e. Lohvu nambe yiiy Islel gaate taakis na vu Lom-ate yêêv bop Sisa me malis?”
Le Yesu lak sil alondpayo nipayaa-ju ni lung la, om nêêl nambe, “Ham oo natee ham ak. Nambe vaati sen ham nawiingin nambe sahi saa-jo?
Ham taato mone taakis ti be saangge le.” Om lavu mone ti la vu be yi,
le mem lingin sil nambe, “Lati kanu osin haale lakaneep-anjo?”
+ o 22:21 Lom 13:7*Le lanêêl laah nambe, “Sisa.” Tombe Yesu nêêl vu sil nambe, “Om ham ambu Sisa-te va na vu Sisa, de Anutu-te va na vu Anutu.”
Lango vakasin-anjo tombe lavindis lôôt, tombe lavuuh yi de lala.
Lalingin Yesu in omaahonôôn lanjimb-ande kandi jak-ato
+ o 22:23 Sin 23:8*Tonde hôôk busin tii-ju hil Sadusi sen danêêl nambe omaahonôôn yimbin-ame le kandi jak naah-ato, ond lala lalingin Yesu nambe,
+ o 22:24 Diu 25:5*“Kaputung, Mose nêêl nambe omaaho ti noow ma de yimb, ond omaahôô-ju hali le gako vehaahôôv in yuuh gako unoopasiv dukanaah mangganaan sen yimb-ato ahembaan.
Tombe bôôy omaaho ti sil o halindin namaavaalu be vindak yuuh dando having hey, tombe sil halindin tuk hako vêêh ti be yimb de noow ma, om sil halindin miin hako hali vane vehaahôôv-ambe yimb,
de gwey wiing nambêênju va timu. Tombe yik sil pin lôôt-ambe la hato sil halindin meey,
sil pin layimb de sil noondin ma, tombe vehaahôôv yimb lakaneep ahus.
Om vu busin sen omaahonôôn yimbin kandi jak naah-ato, ond vehaahôôv-anju le naatu hil namaavaalu be vindak yuuh-anjuuto sil ti tana vane, in sil pin lako vêêh timuu-ju lung laa-to.”
Le sim Yesu nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Ôôye, ham doosin Anutu-te niwêêk osin yite vakasin sen lukaneep hôôk kaapiyaa-to, ondeey ham nakaas paya nambêênja.
Vu busin sen omaahonôôn yimbin kandi jak naah-ato ond vêêh ayuuh moow-ame le gako sil naah e, le nama. Sil e mando nohvu angela-so sen dando baandonii-to.
Vakasin lak omaahonôôn yimbin kandi jak-ato ond mak ham-ame nasevin vakasin sen Anutu nêêl vu ham-ambe neep hôôk yite kaapiyaa-to mava? Nambe,

+ o 22:32 Eks 3:6; Mat 8:11*‘Abalaam ayuuh Isak-ande Yaakop, yaalate Anutu sa.’ Le hamambe yaal layimb om yaal lala valok-ate? Malis, in Anutu ond hil metumin vu voon osin hil pin sen layimb-ambe lala dando metumin-ato silate Anutu yi.”
Hil lango Yesu-te tanasin-anjo tombe lavindis lôôt.
Anutu-te tanasin tii-jo kaluuh tanasin vaalu pin
Hil Palisai lango nambe Yesu-te vakasin-anju wiing-ambe hil Sadusi lavand ma, tombe lasupin lavuh ti,
tombe sil ti omaaho tanasin dangga wiingin nambe sahi Yesu om lingin nambe,
“Kaputung, Mose-te tanasin ti tana savok tanasin vaalu la?”
+ o 22:37 Diu 6:5*Tombe Yesu nêêl vu nambe, “Tanasin ti nambe, ‘Gahem gaving gate Omaaho Bop Anutu osin galompayo doos, be okanum doos, de gakam na doos vu yi timu.’
Tanasin danggakook ti nyendoos-anjo ond mem bopaata lôôt-ambe kaluuh vaalu la.
+ o 22:39-40 Lev 19:18; Gal 5:14; Mat 7:12; Lom 13:9-10*Tonde tanasin ango tu yuuh having nambêênjo nambe, ‘Gahem gaving hil sen dando ngaaho vu hong naambe sen gahem oo naving hong-ato.’
In Mose-te tanasin osin Anutu-te vakasin sen yite hil danêêl langaah-ato pin ond danggakook neep hôôk tanasin yuuh-anjo.”
Kalisi-te danggakook neep vu lati?
Hil Palisai lasupin sil-ambe yoo daahen dando, tonde Yesu lingin sil nambe,
+ o 22:42 Jon 7:42*“Ham akam vu nambe vaati lak omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato? Yite danggakook neep vu lati? Tombe lanêêl nambe, “Danggakook neep vu Devit.”
Tombe nêêl vu sil nambe, “Le nambe vaati sen Vavi Vaambuung vêêl Devit alu lak-ambe nêêl omaahôô-juuto nambe Omaaho Bop? Sen nêêl nambe,

content.text: + o 22:44 Saam 110:1; Mat 26:64; Sin 2:34-35*‘Omaaho Bop nêêl vu sate Omaaho Bop nambe, “Omando sa namangg vasa, de sale aambiing-ambe hil sen dayi hong payaa-to le langgulis hong vaalu kambi.” ’

content: Om sen Devit nêêl omaahôô-juuto nambe, ‘Omaaho Bop’ le nambe vaati sen Omaaho Bop-anju tu Devit-ate hil vu taamusin-ato ti
Tombe omaaho ti me-lohvu nambe naanêêl vakasin ti naah vu Yesu le, tombe hôôk busin-anju layêênin Yesu lakala, de me-dalingin yi yesin laah e.

footnotes.text: Yesu nêêl Devit-ate vakasin-anju in nambe bêêl sil alund jak in kand bu naambe omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato ond yite danggakook neep vu Devit lemu yite niwêêk kaluuh Devit la, ondeey Devit nêêl nambe Omaaho Bop.
